issues.description: Final stock has excess material beyond target tolerance. Resolution cannot establish a pass.

timing_assumptions: Constant commanded vector feed/rapid speed; no acceleration, jerk, lookahead, spindle ramp or controller blending. Cut includes air cutting and plunge/retract. Tool changes add fixed duration, with no implicit travel. Full submitted plan timed even if invalid. Indexed B/C rotation uses simultaneous constant angular speeds plus settle time. No cutting during indexing.
scope: Indexed 3+2 only; table-attached stock and fixtures. Tool-section collision and configured axis limits; whole-machine self-collision is not certified. Gauge length is fixed across tools.

numerics.geometry_backend: trimesh signed distance; double precision, not exact arithmetic
